title: Hub event
description: One record in a hub stream (contract 07, C-07.1 to C-07.6). Events with origin daemon are main-ring entries of a web-chat daemon (web-chat-dev.worktrees/ae-int/lib/core/bus.js emit builds them as {seq, ts, ...event}); the hub lifts seq, ts and kind out into source and kind, and keeps the rest in data after contract 11's projection.

stream.description: The hub stream: chat:<chat_id>, machine:<machine_id>, or hub (C-07.1, section 2).

seq.description: Hub seq: position in the stream, assigned on receipt, gapless within an epoch (C-07.2).

epoch.description: The stream's epoch: ep_ and a ULID, re-minted only when the stream's numbering is rewritten (C-07.4).

id.description: The event's hub id: ev_ and a ULID. Stable for references from other records; never used for order.

at.description: Hub clock at commit, epoch milliseconds. Authoritative time for display; never used for order (C-07.3).

origin.description: Who made the fact: a daemon ring entry, the connector's own observation, or the hub (C-07.5).

kind.description: For origin daemon, the ring entry's kind verbatim (the open set at bus.js:24-130: store, render, clear, pane, dom, graph, comment, capture, queue, wake, wake-ack, packs, brand, project, control, script-error, element kinds). For connector and hub, one of the C-07.5 table's kinds.

op.description: The entry's op when it has one (a queue entry's add, update, remove, clear or receipt; a control entry's interrupt). Copied from data for indexing; data keeps it too.

chat_id.description: The chat id (contract 03 section 2: `cht_` and 26 lowercase Crockford base32 characters). Hub streams and hub events carry the id; link bodies carry the label. The chat the event concerns. Present on every chat-stream event and on chat.daemon events in a machine stream.

machine_id.description: The machine the event concerns or came through. Present when the event came over a link.

source.description: Provenance of an origin daemon event (C-07.1, C-07.12).

ring.description: The source ring. Only the main ring crosses in v1 (C-07.7).

boot.description: A daemon's per-boot token, read from the X-WC-Boot response header where the daemon sends it (C-07.9, Q-07.1), else from GET /api/health (web-chat-dev.worktrees/ae-int/lib/server/routes/health.js:131). Today `${pid}:${Date.now()}` from lib/server/index.js:156; from alpha.4 random per createServer and without the pid (C-07.15, Q-07.8). Opaque to the hub: compared for equality only, never parsed (C-07.36).

seq.description: The entry's seq as the daemon served it. For a capture entry before Q-07.2's rename (alpha.4) this is the capture counter, not the ring position (bus.js:156-158, lib/server/domain/captures.js:131); after it, the ring position, with the counter as capture_seq in data.

ts.description: The entry's ts on the daemon's clock (bus.js:168). Kept for display and diagnostics only.

key.description: The dedupe key, unique per chat (C-07.12): main/<boot>/<seq>, or capture/<surface_gen>/<capture_id> for a capture entry, boot-free (C-07.12a).

via.description: ring: read from GET /api/events or its stream. reconcile: rebuilt from GET /api/captures?since (lib/server/routes/capture.js:280-289) after a catch-up read or a batch that was not contiguous (C-07.12).

actor.description: Who did it, as contract 03 defines a principal. Open here because 03 is normative for its shape. Null for an origin daemon event until the daemon copies 03's actor onto the entries it makes from a relayed request (C-03.21 to C-03.23, C-07.1, Q-07.7); until then only hub records carry one.

data.description: The fact's body. For origin daemon, the ring entry less seq, ts and kind, reduced to contract 11's C-11.18 allowlist by the connector before it sends and by the hub again before it stores (C-07.8). For connector and hub kinds, the fields the C-07.5 table lists.

withheld.description: True when this reader may not see the event's body (C-07.22): data is then absent and seq and kind still hold the place.
